name_en: Confirm the official licence path and enrol in a driving school
name_ar: تأكيد خطوات الرخصة الرسمية والتسجيل في مدرسة القيادة
what: Open Absher / my.gov.sa (service: 'Driving license issuance') and the chosen driving school's official page; write down, in the app, the current steps, prerequisites (e.g., medical check, fees, eye test), the course level assigned, and test dates. Then book the school.
dose: not specified by source (official pages could not be read from the research environment; confirm hours and steps directly on Absher/my.gov.sa and with the school)
why: The official process and required training hours are set by the traffic authority and schools and can change; planning must follow the current official version.
cue_suggestion: Sunday life-admin block
minimum_version: Open the my.gov.sa service page and save the link in the app.
normal_version: Fill a one-page checklist of steps, documents, fees and dates, then book the school's assessment.
bonus_version: Call/WhatsApp the school to confirm course hours for your assessed level and the earliest test slot.
joy_pairing: Treat it as a milestone: each checklist item done unlocks a small reward (favourite drink, a playlist for future drives).
friction_down: Keep national ID, photos and payment method ready in one folder; pre-fill Absher login with 2-step verification enabled.
friction_up_for_competing: Do not open social media until the checklist is filled.
if_then_plan: If it is Sunday life-admin time, then I will open the licence checklist and complete the next unchecked step.
safety_or_stop_rule: Use only official government portals and licensed driving schools; ignore third-party 'fast licence' offers.
notes: my.gov.sa (service 112124) returned 403 and moi.gov.sa/absher.sa timed out from this environment; sds.com.sa is an ERP company, not a driving school. No official hour counts are stated here on purpose.

name_en: Active hazard-perception practice
name_ar: تدريب نشط على إدراك مخاطر الطريق
what: Practise spotting developing hazards using active (respond/predict) exercises: hazard-perception video clips where you click or say the hazard before it happens, 'what happens next' prediction, and commentary driving with the instructor.
dose: not specified by source (meta-analysis: active training and even single sessions gave consistent short-term gains; long-term retention unclear)
why: Hazard perception training produced a large improvement in drivers' hazard-perception skill (g = 0.78), with active training most consistent.

sources.title: The efficacy of hazard perception training and education: A systematic review and meta-analysis
The effectiveness of mandating supervised driving practice requirements on improving road safety outcomes for learner drivers: A systematic review

cue_suggestion: Right after a driving lesson, or the evening before one
minimum_version: Watch 1 hazard clip and name the hazard out loud before it appears.
normal_version: One short active hazard-perception session (clips + prediction) and write 1 hazard you missed in the lesson.
bonus_version: Commentary drive with the instructor: narrate hazards aloud for part of the lesson.
joy_pairing: Make it a game: score your clip reactions and try to beat yesterday's score; do it with a friend/sister who is also learning.
friction_down: Save a playlist of hazard clips (from the driving school or theory app) on the phone home screen.
friction_up_for_competing: Use it as the 'unlock' before evening scrolling.
if_then_plan: If I finish a driving lesson, then I will spend a few minutes on hazard clips and log one hazard I missed.
progression: self-paced; move from clips to commentary driving as the instructor allows
safety_or_stop_rule: Never watch clips or use the phone while driving.
notes: Evidence is on skill tests; the review says transfer to on-road crash outcomes still needs research.

name_en: Build supervised practice across varied conditions
name_ar: تراكم ساعات تدريب تحت الإشراف في ظروف متنوعة
what: After the course, keep accumulating supervised practice (instructor, or as permitted by Saudi traffic rules) and deliberately widen exposure step by step: quiet streets, then busier roads, night, highways, parking, Jeddah/Makkah traffic peaks.
dose: not specified by source (review: more supervised practice associated with safer outcomes, but specific hour thresholds were mixed)
why: Longer learner periods, structured training and greater supervised practice were associated with fewer crashes and offences in early independent driving.

sources.title: The effectiveness of mandating supervised driving practice requirements on improving road safety outcomes for learner drivers: A systematic review

cue_suggestion: Fixed weekly slot (e.g., Friday after Asr) with the supervising person
minimum_version: 10 minutes in a quiet familiar area practising one manoeuvre.
normal_version: One planned practice drive on a pre-chosen route targeting one new condition.
bonus_version: Add a new condition (night/highway) once the current one feels routine.
joy_pairing: Pair with a pleasant destination (favourite café drive-through) and a 'driving playlist' at low volume once confident.
friction_down: Plan the route in the app beforehand; keep a 'conditions ladder' checklist.
if_then_plan: If it is Friday after Asr and the supervisor is free, then I will drive the planned route for today's condition.
tracking_metric: Practice minutes + condition ticked on the ladder
progression: Advance one rung on the conditions ladder only when the previous feels routine (self-paced)
safety_or_stop_rule: Only drive when legally permitted (licence or valid permit with required supervision); stop if very anxious, tired, or in bad visibility (dust/rain).
notes: Review population is mostly young novices in GDL systems; applicability to an adult Saudi learner is by analogy. No sourced driving-anxiety protocol included; if anxiety is strong and persistent, speak to a professional.

name_en: Spaced practice tests for the theory exam
name_ar: اختبارات تدريبية متباعدة للاختبار النظري
what: Prepare the theory test (signs, rules) with short practice-test sessions spread over days instead of one long cram.
dose: not specified by source
why: Practice testing and distributed practice were rated the highest-utility learning techniques in a major review.

sources.title: Improving Students' Learning With Effective Learning Techniques: Promising Directions From Cognitive and Educational Psychology

cue_suggestion: After Isha, before any leisure screen time
minimum_version: 10 practice questions.
normal_version: One practice set and review every wrong answer.
bonus_version: Full mock test under time.
joy_pairing: Track a streak and a rising score chart; do it with tea in a favourite spot.
friction_down: Use the official/school practice material saved on the home screen.
if_then_plan: If I finish Isha, then I will do one short theory practice set before opening social apps.
progression: self-paced; stop when consistently passing mock tests
safety_or_stop_rule: Use only official/school-provided question banks for content accuracy.
notes: Same learning principle can be shared with IELTS study actions in another cluster.

name_en: Track spending for a week, then make a monthly spending plan
name_ar: تتبع المصروفات أسبوعًا ثم خطة صرف شهرية
what: List income sources, track every spend by category for one week, list bills with due dates, then write a simple monthly spending plan; review weekly and update when income or habits change.
dose: Tracking 'one week at a time' is suggested by CFPB; review frequency otherwise not specified by source
why: CFPB's consumer guidance uses income tracker, spending tracker and bill calendar as the steps to build and keep a working budget.

sources.title: CFPB - Budgeting: How to create a budget and stick with it

cue_suggestion: Right after a purchase (log) and on payday (plan)
minimum_version: Log today's spends with one tap each.
normal_version: Weekly 10-minute review of categories vs plan.
bonus_version: Monthly: adjust categories and move any surplus to a goal.
joy_pairing: Visual progress bars per goal; reward a 'good week' with a small planned treat that is inside the budget.
friction_down: Use bank notifications or a one-tap logger; pre-set categories.
friction_up_for_competing: Remove saved cards from impulse-shopping apps.
if_then_plan: If I pay for something, then I will log it before leaving the shop/app.
safety_or_stop_rule: If debts or money stress feel unmanageable, seek help from the bank or a qualified adviser.
notes: Evidence for budgeting per se is thin; this is official guidance, not an RCT-backed dose.

name_en: Automatic transfer to savings on payday
name_ar: تحويل تلقائي للادخار يوم الراتب
what: Set a recurring bank transfer from current to savings account scheduled on payday (pay-yourself-first default).
dose: Amount not specified by source; start small and adjust
why: Defaults strongly shape saving: automatic enrolment raised retirement-plan participation, and defaults show a considerable average effect in meta-analysis (d = 0.68).

sources.title: CFPB - An essential guide to building an emergency fund
The Power of Suggestion: Inertia in 401(k) Participation and Savings Behavior
When and why defaults influence decisions: a meta-analysis of default effects
The effectiveness of nudging: A meta-analysis of choice architecture interventions across behavioral domains

cue_suggestion: Payday (automated)
minimum_version: Any small fixed amount.
normal_version: A set percentage of income that fits the plan.
bonus_version: Raise the amount a little after each pay rise or windfall.
joy_pairing: Name the account after the dream (e.g., 'My car', 'Trip') and watch the balance grow.
friction_down: Automate once; no monthly decision needed.
friction_up_for_competing: Keep savings in a separate account without a debit card.
if_then_plan: If I receive a raise or gift money, then I will increase the automatic transfer that day.
safety_or_stop_rule: Keep enough in current account for bills to avoid overdraft or late fees.
notes: Madrian & Shea is a US employer 401(k) study; generalisation to personal transfers is by principle (defaults/inertia).

name_en: Build an emergency fund in a separate account
name_ar: صندوق طوارئ في حساب منفصل
what: Keep a dedicated cash reserve for unplanned expenses; size the target from the kinds and costs of unexpected expenses you've had; add windfalls (gifts, bonuses) and monitor the running total.
dose: Target not specified by source ('depends on your situation'); even a small amount helps
why: CFPB: an emergency fund provides a cash reserve for unplanned expenses; even a small amount gives some financial security.

sources.title: CFPB - An essential guide to building an emergency fund

cue_suggestion: Payday + whenever a gift/bonus arrives
minimum_version: Start the account with any amount.
normal_version: Automatic monthly top-up until the chosen target.
bonus_version: Save part of every windfall.
joy_pairing: Progress ring toward the target; celebrate milestones (25/50/75/100%).
friction_down: Separate account, auto transfer, balance notifications.
friction_up_for_competing: No card linked to this account.
if_then_plan: If I get gift/bonus money, then I will move part of it to the emergency fund the same day.
safety_or_stop_rule: Use only for true emergencies; refill after use.

name_en: Labelled savings goals (earmark and partition)
name_ar: أهداف ادخار مسماة ومقسّمة
what: Give each saving goal its own named pot/sub-account with a visual reminder (e.g., photo of the goal); optionally split one goal into two pots, and optionally lock a goal pot until a date/amount.
dose: not specified by source
why: In a field experiment, partitioning earmarked money into two accounts and adding a visual reminder of the goal increased saving; a commitment (locked) savings product also increased saving in an RCT.

sources.title: Earmarking and Partitioning: Increasing Saving by Low-Income Households
Tying Odysseus to the Mast: Evidence From a Commitment Savings Product in the Philippines
CFPB - An essential guide to building an emergency fund

cue_suggestion: Monthly money review
minimum_version: Rename one savings pot with its goal.
normal_version: One pot per goal with a picture and target date.
bonus_version: Lock one pot until its date if your bank offers it.
joy_pairing: Use a photo of the goal (car, course, trip) as the pot's cover.
friction_down: Most Saudi banking apps allow multiple savings pots/accounts.
if_then_plan: If I feel like dipping into a goal pot, then I will first look at the goal picture and wait one day.
safety_or_stop_rule: Don't lock money you may need for emergencies (keep LIFE-07 first).
notes: Both RCTs were in low-income populations (India, Philippines); applicability by analogy.

name_en: BNPL (Tabby/Tamara) rules for myself
name_ar: قواعد شخصية للشراء الآن والدفع لاحقًا
what: Use BNPL only for planned, budgeted purchases; keep at most one active plan at a time; add every instalment date to the bill calendar; check the total still fits the plan before confirming.
dose: Personal rule; limits not specified by source
why: CFPB found BNPL risks of loan stacking across lenders, late fees (10.5% of users charged at least one in 2021) and weaker dispute protections; in Saudi Arabia BNPL companies are regulated by SAMA.

sources.title: CFPB Study Details the Rapid Growth of Buy Now, Pay Later Lending (2022)
SAMA Rulebook - Rules for Regulating Buy-Now-Pay-Later (BNPL) Companies (page existence only; rule text not readable)

cue_suggestion: At checkout when BNPL is offered
minimum_version: Pause 10 seconds and ask: is this in my plan?
normal_version: Check active BNPL plans in the app before accepting a new one.
bonus_version: Pay in full instead when possible.
joy_pairing: Every BNPL skipped = the same amount moved to a goal pot (see progress grow).
friction_down: Keep a single 'Instalments' list with due dates and auto-pay from salary account.
friction_up_for_competing: Turn off BNPL one-click/saved accounts in shopping apps.
if_then_plan: If a checkout offers 'split in 4', then I will check my instalments list before accepting.
safety_or_stop_rule: If instalments start overlapping or a payment is missed, stop new BNPL and contact the provider.
notes: CFPB data are US (2021); SAMA rule text could not be read (page content loads dynamically) — only the existence of SAMA BNPL rules is verified.

name_en: Monthly bills & subscriptions review
name_ar: مراجعة شهرية للفواتير والاشتراكات
what: Keep a bill calendar of all recurring charges (subscriptions, phone, instalments) and once a month cancel or downgrade anything unused.
dose: Bill calendar per CFPB; monthly review cadence is a practical choice (not specified by source)
why: Knowing what bills are due and when helps spot timing mismatches and keep the budget accurate.

sources.title: CFPB - Budgeting: How to create a budget and stick with it

cue_suggestion: First weekend of the month
minimum_version: Check the list of subscriptions in the phone's app store settings.
normal_version: Review bank statement recurring charges and cancel one unused.
bonus_version: Negotiate or switch a plan (mobile/internet).
joy_pairing: Move saved money straight to a fun goal pot.
friction_down: Keep the bill calendar in the app with reminders 3 days before each due date.
friction_up_for_competing: Use calendar reminders before free trials convert.
if_then_plan: If I start a free trial, then I will set a reminder 2 days before it ends.
notes: Practical/low-risk; no trial evidence for subscription reviews specifically.

name_en: Wishlist cooling-off before non-essential purchases
name_ar: قائمة أمنيات وفترة تهدئة قبل الشراء غير الضروري
what: Put non-essential items on a wishlist with the date added; buy only if still wanted after a waiting period and it fits the plan.
dose: Waiting period not specified by any verified source; choose one (e.g., a few days) and adjust
why: Practical self-control strategy; no verified trial evidence found for personal cooling-off periods.
cue_suggestion: When you feel the urge to buy online
minimum_version: Add to wishlist instead of cart.
normal_version: Review the wishlist weekly; buy at most the top item if in budget.
bonus_version: Delete items you no longer want and log the 'saved' amount.
joy_pairing: Browsing the wishlist is allowed and fun; celebrate 'saved' totals.
friction_down: Wishlist widget in the app.
friction_up_for_competing: Log out of shopping apps; remove saved cards.
if_then_plan: If I want to buy something not in my plan, then I will add it to the wishlist and decide at the weekly review.
tracking_metric: Items bought vs removed from wishlist
notes: Honest label: practical, low-risk, evidence not verified.

name_en: Just-in-time money learning before big decisions
name_ar: تعلم مالي في وقته قبل القرارات الكبيرة
what: Before a specific decision (car purchase/financing, first job salary account, savings product), spend a focused session learning exactly that topic from official sources, then act soon after.
dose: not specified by source
why: Meta-analyses show financial education effects are real but modest and decay over time, supporting learning tied to an imminent behaviour.

sources.title: Financial Literacy, Financial Education, and Downstream Financial Behaviors
Financial education affects financial knowledge and downstream behaviors

cue_suggestion: When a money decision is added to the calendar
minimum_version: Read one official page on the decision.
normal_version: One session comparing options and total cost, then decide within the week.
bonus_version: Ask a knowledgeable family member to review.
joy_pairing: Treat it as a research mini-project (UX-research mindset).
friction_down: Keep a list of trusted official sources (SAMA, bank product pages).
if_then_plan: If I schedule a big purchase, then I will book a 30-minute research session in the 3 days before.
safety_or_stop_rule: Don't rely on social-media 'finance tips' for regulated products.
notes: Fernandes 2014 finds tiny average effects and decay; Kaiser 2022 (76 RCTs) finds larger positive effects than earlier work. Both support focused, timely learning over long generic courses.

name_en: Daily 10-minute room reset
name_ar: ترتيب سريع يومي للغرفة
what: A short daily reset: clear surfaces, return items to their homes, put clothes in the hamper, set up tomorrow's items.
dose: not specified by source; 10 minutes is a planning estimate
why: Observational studies link homes described as cluttered with worse mood and flatter cortisol slopes in women, and clutter with lower subjective well-being; causality is not established.

sources.title: No place like home: home tours correlate with daily patterns of mood and cortisol
The dark side of home: Assessing possession 'clutter' on subjective well-being

cue_suggestion: Right after Isha prayer, or before the night skincare routine
minimum_version: Clear one surface (desk or bed).
normal_version: 10-minute timer reset of the whole room.
bonus_version: Prepare tomorrow's outfit and bag.
joy_pairing: One favourite song or podcast episode = the reset; light a scent/incense after.
friction_down: Hamper and a 'drop tray' near the door; fewer items on surfaces.
friction_up_for_competing: Phone charges outside the room until the reset is done.
if_then_plan: If I finish Isha, then I will start the 10-minute reset timer.
notes: Roster et al. abstract could not be read (publisher rate-limit); only title/DOI verified, so claim kept general.

name_en: A home for everything: one zone per week
name_ar: مكان لكل شيء: منطقة واحدة أسبوعيًا
what: Declutter and organise one zone per week (desk, wardrobe shelf, makeup, cables), giving every kept item a labelled home; remove/donate what isn't used.
dose: not specified by source
why: Practical, low-risk; supports the daily reset. Evidence linking clutter to wellbeing is observational only.

sources.title: No place like home: home tours correlate with daily patterns of mood and cortisol

cue_suggestion: Saturday morning after breakfast
minimum_version: One drawer.
normal_version: One zone in about 30 minutes.
bonus_version: Donate bag delivered the same week.
joy_pairing: Before/after photos (a mini design case study); music.
friction_down: Keep bins, labels and a donate bag ready.
if_then_plan: If it is Saturday after breakfast, then I will pick this week's zone from the list and set a 30-minute timer.
notes: Practical/low-risk label.

name_en: Batch laundry on a fixed day
name_ar: غسيل الملابس في يوم ثابت
what: Do laundry in batches on fixed day(s): wash, dry, fold and put away in the same session.
dose: not specified by source
why: Practical: batching and a stable cue reduce decisions and pile-ups; no direct evidence.
cue_suggestion: Same weekday each week
minimum_version: Start one load.
normal_version: Wash, fold and put away one full batch.
bonus_version: Iron/prepare the week's outfits.
joy_pairing: Fold while watching a favourite series episode.
friction_down: Separate hampers by colour so sorting is done already.
if_then_plan: If it is laundry day, then I will start the first load before breakfast.
notes: Practical/low-risk label.

name_en: Weekly life-admin block with errand batching
name_ar: وقت أسبوعي للمهام الإدارية وتجميع المشاوير
what: One fixed weekly block to process the admin inbox: payments, forms, bookings, calls; group errands by location into one trip.
dose: not specified by source
why: Planning when and where to act (implementation intentions) improves remembering and following through on intended tasks.

sources.title: The effect of implementation intention on prospective memory: a systematic and meta-analytic review
Implementation Intentions and Goal Achievement: A Meta-analysis of Effects and Processes

cue_suggestion: Sunday after Asr
minimum_version: Clear 2 items from the admin inbox.
normal_version: Process the whole admin list and plan errands by area.
bonus_version: Pre-book next week's appointments.
joy_pairing: Favourite drink + a tidy desk; tick-off animation in the app.
friction_down: Capture every admin task into one inbox list the moment it appears.
friction_up_for_competing: Do Not Disturb during the block.
if_then_plan: If it is Sunday after Asr, then I will open the admin inbox and start with the oldest item.
notes: Errand batching itself is practical (no direct evidence).

name_en: Documents & renewals register with reminders
name_ar: سجل الوثائق والتجديدات مع تذكيرات
what: Keep one register of documents and expiry dates (national ID, passport, driving licence once issued, car registration/insurance, bank cards, subscriptions) and appointments, each with calendar/phone reminders ahead of the date.
dose: Reminder lead time not specified by source
why: Text-message reminders increased attendance at appointments vs no reminders (moderate-quality evidence), and offloading intentions to external reminders reduces memory demand.

sources.title: Mobile phone messaging reminders for attendance at healthcare appointments (Cochrane)
Cognitive Offloading

cue_suggestion: When any document or appointment is created
minimum_version: Add one expiry date with a reminder.
normal_version: Register complete; review monthly.
bonus_version: Scanned copies stored in encrypted backup (see LIFE-19).
joy_pairing: Satisfying 'all green' status screen.
friction_down: Use the app's template fields; double reminders (early + near date).
if_then_plan: If I get a new document or booking, then I will add it to the register before putting it away.
safety_or_stop_rule: Don't store ID numbers in unencrypted notes; renew via official portals only.
notes: Cochrane review is for healthcare appointments; extension to other appointments is by analogy.

name_en: If-then plan for every one-off task
name_ar: خطة (إذا... فسأ...) لكل مهمة لمرة واحدة
what: When adding a one-off task, attach a specific cue: 'If [time/place/event], then I will [action]'. Imagining the moment strengthens it.
dose: not specified by source
why: Implementation intentions improved prospective memory in healthy young adults (d = 0.445), more with verbal + imagery form (d = 0.59).

sources.title: The effect of implementation intention on prospective memory: a systematic and meta-analytic review
Implementation Intentions and Goal Achievement: A Meta-analysis of Effects and Processes

cue_suggestion: At task capture
minimum_version: Add a time or place to the task.
normal_version: Write the full if-then and picture the moment for a few seconds.
bonus_version: Link it to an existing routine step.
joy_pairing: Quick-add templates make it feel effortless.
friction_down: App prompt field 'When/where will you do this?'.
if_then_plan: If I add a task without a cue, then I will add the 'if' part before saving.
notes: Useful as an app-wide feature across clusters.

name_en: 3-2-1 backups, automatic
name_ar: نسخ احتياطي 3-2-1 تلقائي
what: Keep 3 copies of important files, on 2 different types of storage (e.g., laptop drive and cloud), with 1 copy off-site; make backups automatic and test a restore; organise files in a simple folder structure (e.g., Personal / Portfolio / Study / Documents).
dose: 3 copies, 2 media types, 1 off-site (CISA); frequency: 'automatically and regularly'
why: CISA recommends the 3-2-1 rule, automatic regular backups, offline copies and tested restores to protect against data loss and ransomware.

sources.title: CISA - Back Up Government Data (3-2-1 rule)

cue_suggestion: First day of month: check backup status
minimum_version: Turn on automatic cloud backup for phone photos and Documents.
normal_version: Add an external drive backup; monthly check that backups ran.
bonus_version: Quarterly: restore one file to test; tidy Downloads into the folder structure.
joy_pairing: Peace of mind for the portfolio: pair with a portfolio-archive moment (export latest Figma files).
friction_down: Automatic backup settings; drive kept next to the laptop charger.
if_then_plan: If it is the first day of the month, then I will check the backup date and plug in the external drive.
safety_or_stop_rule: Encrypt backups holding documents/ID scans; keep one copy offline.
notes: CISA page is aimed at government organisations but states the 3-2-1 rule generically; the CISA consumer PDF returned 403.

name_en: Turn on 2-step verification, email first
name_ar: تفعيل التحقق بخطوتين بدءًا بالبريد
what: Turn on 2-step verification (MFA) on email first, then banking, Absher, social media, shopping, cloud storage and the password manager; prefer an authenticator app or passkey where offered.
dose: One-off setup per account
why: NCSC calls turning on 2SV the first and most important step to protect you if your password gets phished; CISA advises enabling MFA on email, banks and other important accounts.

sources.title: NCSC - Top tips for staying secure online: Password managers
CISA Secure Our World - Turn On MFA

cue_suggestion: Life-admin block; one account per week
minimum_version: Email account only.
normal_version: Email + bank + Absher + main social account.
bonus_version: All accounts in the password manager; store backup codes securely.
joy_pairing: Security 'score' in the app filling up.
friction_down: Follow Settings > Security > 2-step; install one authenticator app.
if_then_plan: If an account shows 'turn on 2-step verification', then I will do it immediately.
safety_or_stop_rule: Save recovery/backup codes offline; never share one-time codes with anyone (including callers claiming to be a bank or government).
notes: Saudi NCA guidance not verified (site not tested/reachable); UK NCSC and US CISA used.

name_en: Use a password manager
name_ar: استخدام مدير كلمات المرور
what: Use a password manager to generate strong, unique passwords per account; give email a strong separate password; protect the manager with 2SV.
dose: One-off setup, then as-needed
why: NCSC: password managers create strong unique passwords, autofill, sync across devices and alert on breaches.

sources.title: NCSC - Top tips for staying secure online: Password managers

cue_suggestion: Whenever you log in to an account not yet in the manager
minimum_version: Save the next login into the manager.
normal_version: Change reused passwords on important accounts.
bonus_version: Move to passkeys where offered.
joy_pairing: Never typing passwords again is the reward.
friction_down: Browser and phone autofill enabled.
friction_up_for_competing: Turn off browser 'save password' prompts outside the manager.
if_then_plan: If I log in somewhere with an old password, then I will replace it with a generated one.
safety_or_stop_rule: Protect the manager with a strong master password and 2SV.

name_en: Weekly partial water change + gravel clean
name_ar: تغيير جزئي أسبوعي للماء وتنظيف الحصى
what: Replace part of the tank water each week and vacuum the gravel to remove waste; use dechlorinated water at tank temperature.
dose: 10-25% of tank water weekly (RSPCA, tropical fish)
why: Regular partial water changes with gravel cleaning keep water quality safe for fish.

sources.title: RSPCA Knowledgebase - How should I care for my tropical fish?

cue_suggestion: Same weekday, e.g., Friday morning
minimum_version: Remove and replace ~10% water.
normal_version: 10-25% change with gravel vacuum.
bonus_version: Wipe glass and trim plants.
joy_pairing: Relaxing music; enjoy watching fish after.
friction_down: Bucket, siphon and conditioner stored together near the tank.
if_then_plan: If it is Friday morning, then I will do the water change before breakfast.
safety_or_stop_rule: If fish gasp at the surface or look ill, test water and seek advice from an aquatic vet/specialist.
notes: Species-specific needs vary (goldfish vs tropical).

name_en: Feed small amounts at fixed times
name_ar: إطعام كميات صغيرة في أوقات ثابتة
what: Feed only what fish eat within a couple of minutes, at consistent times; remove uneaten food.
dose: Sources differ: RSPCA Australia (tropical) once a day, what is eaten in under 2 minutes; RSPCA UK two or three times a day, what is eaten in 2-5 minutes. Follow advice for your species.
why: Overfeeding degrades water quality, and fish are more susceptible to poor water than to a lack of food.

cue_suggestion: After breakfast (and evening if feeding twice)
minimum_version: One small feeding.
normal_version: Feeding per species schedule.
bonus_version: Varied diet appropriate to species.

friction_down: Food container next to the tank with a small scoop.
if_then_plan: If I finish breakfast, then I will feed the fish and check they all eat.
safety_or_stop_rule: When away, leave pre-portioned meals with a caretaker; avoid holiday feeding blocks (RSPCA UK).

name_en: Test water and rinse filter in tank water
name_ar: فحص الماء وشطف الفلتر بماء الحوض
what: Test ammonia and nitrite; rinse the filter media lightly in a bucket of tank water (not tap water) when clogged or monthly.
dose: Test every 2-3 days for the first 6 weeks, then every 1-2 weeks; filter rinse monthly or when clogged, whichever first (RSPCA Australia)
why: Monitoring and gentle filter maintenance protect water quality.

cue_suggestion: With the weekly water change
minimum_version: Test ammonia only.
normal_version: Test ammonia + nitrite and log values.
bonus_version: Monthly filter rinse in tank water.
joy_pairing: Water-quality chart in the app; 'healthy tank' streak.
friction_down: Test kit stored with water-change kit.
if_then_plan: If I finish the water change, then I will run the test and log it.
progression: Reduce testing frequency after the first 6 weeks (per source)
safety_or_stop_rule: If ammonia/nitrite are detectable, do an extra water change and seek specialist advice.
